steps.title: Which line moved
steps.say: The line you dragged was the supply curve, not demand. Supply shifted right by 2, so sellers now offer more at every price.

steps.title: Why price falls
steps.say: With more on offer at the old price, sellers compete for buyers and cut prices. Buyers then want more, so the equilibrium moves down along demand: price 4, quantity 6.

steps.title: Now demand
steps.say: Now try the demand curve. When demand shifts right, the equilibrium moves up along supply, so price rises. First I reset supply.

steps.title: Try it
steps.say: Drag each curve yourself. A shift of supply moves price the opposite way from quantity. A shift of demand moves both up or both down.
